exposure: mHealth intervention (interactive, educational text messages and appointment reminders)
outcome: postpartum depression scores (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: 191 women receiving OB/GYN care in a clinic between November 2019 and April 2020.
finding: Automated mHealth text messages alone did not significantly improve adherence to the 6-week postpartum visit or other secondary outcomes compared to routine care.
